name: fleetq
title: Fleetq
description: Show the GPU fleet, the running job on each box, how many jobs are queued, and the models it serves.
author: josef

commands.name: fleet-status
commands.title: Fleet Status
commands.subtitle: fleetq
commands.description: Current fleet, running job per box and queue length.

commands.name: fleet-menu-bar
commands.title: Fleet Queue in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: fleetq
commands.description: Running and queued job counts in the menu bar, refreshed every minute.

commands.name: fleet-models
commands.title: Fleet Models
commands.subtitle: fleetq
commands.description: Every model the fleet serves, with its URL and the name fleetq sync-agents gives it in Pi, omp and OpenCode.

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: Server URL
preferences.description: fleetq server. Empty: ~/.config/fleetq/url, else http://fleetq:8470. Reads with ~/.config/fleetq/readonly_token.

preferences.name: owners
preferences.title: Your Owner Names
preferences.description: Jobs to mark as yours, comma-separated; * matches anything (e.g. you@laptop, claude-*). Empty: user@host, the CLI's default.
